boundary: Runtime.start immediately before Runtime.item for the prepared user batch
capture: Real Runtime.start executes team authorization, metadata preparation, and model context. The oracle commits and clones the caller-written pre-state before applying the captured item call.
not_applicable: Start/delta/snapshot/completion ordering applies only to stream notifications, not prepared submissions or token usage.

An identical replay has a persisted receipt; fresh Python provider notifications do not carry this caller envelope. The oracle uses Runtime.save_receipt for that envelope and Rust verifies no writes on replay.
The scheduler refuses radio_turn and radioAnswerTurnId with radio-policy before prepared submission. Plain radio is allowed by assert_events.
Python represents a stopped agent as paused with autoWake=false, not literal status=stopped.
